response.justification: Bogdan has extensive technical experience, including leadership in developer tooling and testing infrastructure, but his people management experience is limited to informal mentoring and team setup rather than formal management roles. His mobile-platform knowledge is minimal, and while he has a strong technical background, his alignment with the specific needs of a large mobile platform ecosystem is unclear. His recent roles focus more on full-stack development than engineering productivity leadership.
strengths: Strong technical expertise in developer tools, testing, and build systems (e.g., GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts).
Proven leadership in technical areas (e.g., setting up CI/CD, organizing Refactoring Dojos, mentoring teams).
Diverse programming language experience (D, TypeScript, Java, C++) relevant to tooling and infrastructure.
concerns: Limited formal people management experience (only 2 years in leadership roles, not explicitly in people management).
Minimal mobile-platform knowledge or experience with large-scale mobile ecosystems.
Recent roles emphasize full-stack development over engineering productivity leadership.
